notes: Post-review regression cases; not held-out evidence. Original version-2 suite preserved byte-for-byte.

tasks.prompt: For a policy pi, V(s)=4 and Q(s,a)=6. Define the advantage, interpret its sign, and show how an on-policy actor and critic can use a TD error. Is adding each TD error to a stored A(s,a) necessarily learning the defined advantage?

criteria.updates: Separate actor policy/preference update from critic value update; no unconditional A+=TD advantage-learning claim.
criteria.conditions: State the exact-critic/on-policy conditions for the TD advantage identity and approximate-critic limitations.

tasks.prompt: A forgetting model predicts P(t)=0.8*(0.9**t). Which axes make it a straight line? Compare with P(t)=0.8*t**(-0.9), derive the transformations, and explain whether a straight-looking plot alone establishes the better model.

criteria.axes: Exponential: log vertical response and linear time; power: log-log.
criteria.scope: Plot does not establish mechanism or best statistical model; account for observation error and transformation.
